description: The chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of various models on two datasets, PHEME and PolitiFact, comparing the performance of different configurations. The horizontal axis contains categories labeled "Ours", "w/o text", "w/o select", "w/o emotion", and "w/o cognition", while the vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)", ranging from 75.0 to 95.0 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. For PHEME, the bars are colored as follows: "Ours" is maroon at 89.84%, "w/o text" is orange at 80.10%, "w/o select" is light blue at 88.80%, "w/o emotion" is blue at 87.34%, and "w/o cognition" is dark blue at 87.17%. For PolitiFact, the bars have the same color scheme, with values: "Ours" at 90.57%, "w/o text" at 83.02%, "w/o select" at 89.62%, "w/o emotion" at 84.91%, and "w/o cognition" at 87.74%. The bars are grouped by dataset, with the same categories appearing in both groups, and are not sorted in a specific order. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color representation.
